source: We need to do anything we can to ensure quality education for our youngsters. Let's see how this program develops and whether it seems to work or not.
zh: 我们需要尽一切努力确保我们的年轻人获得优质教育。让我们看看这个程序是如何开发的以及它是否有效。

source: Programs like Head Start are the only way that we will end poverty in our cities and rural districts. I fought for this program from the beginning and I will support it as President.
zh: 像 Head Start 这样的计划是我们消除城市和农村地区贫困的唯一途径。我从一开始就为这个计划而奋斗，作为总统我将支持它。

source: Lyndon Johnson, in his crude way, swears that he will slit your throat if you oppose his policies on Vietnam while campaigning. Will you risk his wrath and be your own man on the trail?
zh: 林登·约翰逊以他粗鲁的方式发誓，如果你在竞选时反对他的越南政策，他会割断你的喉咙。你愿意冒着他的愤怒的风险，在路上做自己的人吗？

source: Do you believe that the black community in most cities overreacted to the assassination of Martin Luther King this past April?
zh: 您是否认为大多数城市的黑人社区对今年四月马丁·路德·金的暗杀反应过度？

source: The reaction that occurred should terrify any thinking American. Entire neighborhoods were burned and pillaged. They even looted their own storekeepers in many cities.
zh: 所发生的反应应该让任何有思想的美国人感到恐惧。整个街区都被烧毁和掠夺。他们甚至在许多城市抢劫自己的店主。

source: That was a very tough event for many of us to take, no matter what our backgrounds were. I believe that more precautions should have been taken to keep things from getting out of hand, but we must also remember that most Negroes wanted no part of these riots.
zh: 对于我们许多人来说，无论我们的背景如何，这都是一次非常艰难的事件。我认为应该采取更多预防措施来防止事情失控，但我们也必须记住，大多数黑人不想参与这些骚乱。

source: I believe that both the black community and the police overreacted in many areas. First and foremost, we must speak out against violence wherever it may occur -- and against whoever is the source of it.
zh: 我认为黑人社区和警察在许多领域都反应过度。首先也是最重要的一点，我们必须大声疾呼反对暴力，无论暴力发生在哪里，也无论暴力的根源是谁。

source: That's not an entirely relevant question, because I agree with Johnson's stance in Vietnam. We cannot cave in to Communist aggression and maintain our standing in the world.
zh: 这不是一个完全相关的问题，因为我同意约翰逊在越南的立场。我们不能屈服于共产党的侵略并维持我们在世界上的地位。

source: I have no problems opposing the policies of Lyndon Johnson. If he wants to try and sabotage my campaign, we'll just have to live with it.
zh: 我对反对林登·约翰逊的政策没有任何问题。如果他想尝试破坏我的竞选活动，我们就只能忍受了。

source: Johnson is a deeply unpopular President. I don't think his threats are credible here. I will loudly call for peace in Vietnam.
zh: 约翰逊是一位非常不受欢迎的总统。我认为他的威胁在这里不可信。我将大声呼吁越南和平。

source: What will be the overall message of your campaign?
zh: 您的活动的总体信息是什么？

source: What is more important to you -- competing with Nixon in the border states (to help Humphrey) or winning over Humphrey voters in the northern cities (to help Nixon)?
zh: 对你来说哪个更重要——与边境州的尼克松竞争（帮助汉弗莱）还是赢得北部城市的汉弗莱选民（帮助尼克松）？

source: Will you try to compete with Johnson and Humphrey's machine in Texas?
zh: 你会尝试在得克萨斯州中与约翰逊和汉弗莱的机器竞争吗？

source: If there is no majority in the electoral college, what are your goals at the bargaining table?
zh: 如果选举人团没有获得多数席位，您在谈判桌上的目标是什么？

source: I am campaigning on the issue of ending desegregation. That is my appeal and that is the issue I will stick to.
zh: 我正在就结束废除种族隔离问题开展竞选活动。这是我的诉求，也是我将坚持的问题。

source: I'm opposed to desegregation, environmentalism, defeatism, social engineering, busing, declining property values, and unchecked rioting. My candidacy appeals to southerners and northerners alike.
zh: 我反对废除种族隔离、环保主义、失败主义、社会工程、公交车、房产价值下降和不受控制的骚乱。我的候选资格对南方人和北方人都有吸引力。

source: You know, beyond the racial thing I do have other policies. I have worked tirelessly in Alabama on behalf of the poor and downtrodden, and I will do the same as President of the United States.
zh: 你知道，除了种族问题之外，我还有其他政策。我在阿拉巴马州中为穷人和受压迫者不知疲倦地工作，作为美国总统我也会做同样的事情。

source: I am a serious candidate for President of the United States. I will protect law-abiding Americans from social disorder and I will win the war in Vietnam.
zh: 我是美国总统的认真候选人。我将保护守法的美国人免受社会混乱的影响，我将赢得越南战争。

source: Texas should be fertile ground for the George Wallace message. If Humphrey and Johnson get into a rift, I think we've got a real shot in that state. I will try my best to win it.
zh: 得克萨斯州应该是乔治·华莱士消息的沃土。如果汉弗莱和约翰逊出现裂痕，我认为我们在那种状态下有真正的机会。我会尽全力去赢得它。

source: I'm more worried about keeping the rest of the South from going to Nixon. I'm less concerned about Humphrey's chances in Texas.
zh: 我更担心阻止南方其他人去尼克松。我不太关心汉弗莱在得克萨斯州中的机会。

source: I'm just going to run my campaign and whatever happens between those two will happen.
zh: 我只是要开展我的竞选活动，两者之间发生的任何事情都会发生。

source: It looks like Nixon is the favorite, so I'm going to focus most of my efforts on campaigning where he's ahead.
zh: 看起来尼克松是最受欢迎的，所以我将把大部分精力集中在他领先的竞选活动上。

source: Humphrey and the Democrats need to know in the future that they cannot ignore the due concerns of the South and win elections. I will focus on winning potential Humphrey supporters.
zh: 汉弗莱民主党未来需要知道，他们不能忽视南方的应有关切并赢得选举。我将专注于赢得潜在的汉弗莱支持者。

source: I will support whatever candidate agrees to rescind the Civil Rights Act of 1964 and agrees to appoint justices who will overturn Brown v. Board of Education. If no candidate agrees to those conditions, then I will not support either one of them.
zh: 我将支持任何同意废除 1964 年民权法案并同意任命将推翻的法官的候选人 布朗诉教育委员会案。如果没有候选人同意这些条件，那么我不会支持其中任何一个。

source: There's not a dime's worth of difference between the Democrats and Republicans. My goal is to win this election outright.
zh: 民主党和共和党之间没有一毛钱的区别。我的目标是彻底赢得这次选举。

source: Whatever ends up happening on election day, I cannot comment about the aftermath at this point. If that scenario develops I will hear what each side has to say and make a decision at that point.
zh: 无论选举日最终发生什么，我目前无法对后果发表评论。如果出现这种情况，我将听取各方的意见并做出决定。

source: This position is too dovish for the mainstream of the Republican Party. In the future you might do better to take a more moderate stance.
zh: 这个立场对于共和党的主流来说过于鸽派。将来你可能会采取更温和的立场。

source: This is vintage Nixon. You should do well with your appeals to law and order as long as your rhetoric doesn't sound too extreme.
zh: 这是复古的尼克松。只要你的言辞听起来不太极端，你就应该很好地表达你对法律与秩序的诉求。

source: The election closes in chaos. Peace talks collapse, you accuse Nixon, Nixon accuses the Democrats of bugging his plane, and the upshot is mass confusion and anger among the voters. Good luck tonight!
zh: 选举在混乱中结束。和谈破裂，你指责尼克松，尼克松指责民主党窃听他的飞机，结果是选民中的大规模混乱和愤怒。祝今晚好运！

source: Stick to your bread-and-butter appeals. This is red meat for the kind of people who will vote for you this fall.
zh: 坚持你的基本诉求。对于今年秋天投票给你的人来说，这是红肉。

source: This is not what your supporters want to hear out of you.
zh: 这不是你的支持者想从你嘴里听到的。

source: This is anathema to your voting base. They are talking about dumping you now and just voting for Nixon.
zh: 这对你们的投票基础来说是一种诅咒。他们现在正在讨论甩掉你，只是投票给尼克松。

source: It looks like Humphrey has enjoyed a last minute surge in the polls, thanks to a breakthrough in peace negotiations. Will this help cause a deadlock in the electoral college?
zh: 由于和平谈判取得突破，汉弗莱的民调支持率似乎在最后一刻飙升。这会导致选举人团陷入僵局吗？

source: Do you plan to make a strong effort in any of the non-Southern states?
zh: 您是否计划在南方以外的州做出大力努力？

source: My goal is to sweep the South and prevent either candidate from achieving an electoral majority. I will make this region my primary focus.
zh: 我的目标是横扫南方并阻止任何一位候选人获得选举多数。我将把这个地区作为我的主要关注点。

source: I will stick to the states where Richard Nixon is leading, and emphasize my credentials as a law-and-order conservative. If I can keep Nixon below 270, I have a real chance at brokering an end to desegregation after this election.
zh: 我将坚持理查德·尼克松领先的州，并强调我作为法律和秩序保守派的资历。如果我能将尼克松保持在 270 以下，我就有真正的机会在这次选举后促成废除种族隔离。

source: I am a national candidate, and my law-and-order appeal is universal. I will travel into the North and the West and campaign for any voter who is concerned about the future of our country.
zh: 我是一名全国候选人，我对法律和秩序的呼吁是普遍的。我将前往北部和西部，为所有关心我们国家未来的选民竞选。

source: We need to teach the Democrats a lesson this year. I will work tirelessly to pry white northern votes away from Humphrey, so that future candidates on our side know they'd best not trifle with the South.
zh: 今年我们需要给民主党一个教训。我将孜孜不倦地努力从汉弗莱中夺走北方白人的选票，以便我们这一边未来的候选人知道他们最好不要玩弄南方。

source: What can you say to the people of the South to dampen the appeal of Richard Nixon?
zh: 你能对南方人民说什么来抑制理查德·尼克松的吸引力？

source: Richard Nixon is a California yankee and an interloper. He does not deserve the support of a decent southern man.
zh: 理查德·尼克松是一个加利福尼亚州洋基人和闯入者。他不值得一个正派南方人的支持。

source: I have more credibility than Nixon does on the issues of law-and-order. I trust that southerners will see through his empty appeals on this issue.
zh: 在法律和秩序问题上我比尼克松更有可信度。我相信南方人会看穿他在这个问题上的空洞呼吁。

source: I'm more worried about sticking it to Humphrey than I am about Nixon. If it comes down to a negotiated election, I'd rather have Nixon in the driver's seat because I think we can work with him.
zh: 我更担心将其坚持到汉弗莱，而不是尼克松。如果归结为协商选举，我宁愿让尼克松掌舵，因为我认为我们可以与他合作。
